text: dsh-summary-panel 是面向 DSH Web 的会话摘要面板插件。它将可切换的摘要面板挂到会话界面，并提供可扩展的会话摘要分区。内置输出分区会汇总会话中已发布的文件产物，按最近记录展示去重后的路径，用户可展开列表并点击文件在当前工作区打开。面板状态按会话保存，支持桌面浮层和移动端抽屉式展示，也提供供其他客户端插件注册分区的组件接口。适合在 DSH Web 中快速查看会话产出的文件或添加自定义摘要内容；无需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-summary-panel adds a summary panel to DSH Web. A session header toggle opens per-session content with a list of recent unique file outputs. Users can expand the list and open files in the workspace. Client plugins can register custom sections. It adapts to mobile and needs no API key.
想在 DSH Web 的会话页面里快速查看这次产出的文件。
给我一个能按会话保存开关状态的摘要侧栏。
I want to add custom sections to a DSH conversation summary panel.
dsh-summary-panel 的功能「会话文件输出」：在摘要面板的“输出”分区聚合会话各轮发布的文件，按最新记录去重并列出路径；默认显示五项，可展开或收起，点击条目会在会话工作区打开对应文件。
dsh-summary-panel 的功能「可扩展摘要面板」：会话标题栏按钮可切换当前会话的摘要浮层，状态按会话持久化；插件还注册会话级摘要分区插槽，其他客户端插件可添加自己的内容。

dsh-summary-panel README · dsh-summary-panel：English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

An extensible Codex-style conversation summary panel for DeepSeek Harness Web.

The list icon in the session header toggles a compact 320px popover. Its height grows with its content until it reaches the available viewport height, then the content scrolls. It stays aligned to the conversation edge and to the left of open Harness tool details. On mobile it becomes a dismissible right drawer. Open state is persisted per session.

dsh-summary-panel README · Built-in outputs：The Outputs section reads successful file mutations published by `ui-deliverables`. It aggregates all loaded Turns, keeps each exact path once at its latest successful sequence, and lists the most recent files first. Five files are shown initially, with explicit expand and collapse controls. Clicking a row resolves it against the session workspace and opens it through Harness.
dsh-summary-panel README · Built-in outputs：An empty conversation shows **No outputs yet**. The built-in section has no creation action because the panel does not own a file creation workflow.

dsh-summary-panel README · Install：Install a reviewed commit into a DSH profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:hzthzt/dsh-summary-panel#<commit-sha>
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config
dsh --profile <profile> web
```

The repository commits `lib/`, so Git installation does not need to build the package. A local tarball can be installed instead:

```sh
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-summary-panel-0.1.0.tgz
```

dsh-summary-panel README · Extension API：Every section receives the standard session props, including `sessionId`, `useSession`, and `useSessions`, plus `presentation: 'pinned' | 'overlay'` and `closePanel()`.

The Client module also augments `ctx.summaryPanel`:

```ts
ctx.summaryPanel.open(sessionId)
ctx.summaryPanel.close(sessionId)
ctx.summaryPanel.toggle(sessionId)
```

dsh-summary-panel README · Extension API：Public presentation primitives are `SummarySection`, `SummaryItem`, and `SummaryEmpty`. `SummarySection` shows its plus action only when both `actionLabel` and `onAction` are provided.

dsh-summary-panel README · Layout compatibility：Version `0.1.0` targets DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.1.1-rc.2` at commit `b150a551b8d465e31e418e1b2eaf5e79bbb7d28e`.

Popover placement assumes the baseline AppFrame order: `[data-shell-overlay]` follows the details column. The plugin uses its width to keep the popover to the left of open tool details, but never replaces `conversation`, `details`, or another single slot and never mutates the center column. If the DOM cannot be discovered or measured, it falls back to a right-aligned popover.

dsh-summary-panel README · Layout compatibility：When another shell plugin exposes a visible `[data-dsh-toggle-cluster]`, the summary button aligns immediately before that cluster; otherwise it stays in the native session-header utilities slot. Shell buttons and resize handles do not dismiss an open summary, while Escape, the summary toggle, mobile backdrop, and an ordinary click in non-interactive content retain their close behavior.
